Read input: ym2149_logic_combined.v · Open raw
module ym2149_logic (
    input          RESET,
    input          CLK,
    input          CE,
    input          SEL,
    input          MODE,
    input          BC,
    input          BDIR,
    input   [7:0]  DI,
    output  [7:0]  CHANNEL_A,
    output  [7:0]  CHANNEL_B,
    output  [7:0]  CHANNEL_C
);

// Internal registers and logic for the YM2149 functionality
reg [7:0] reg_a, reg_b, reg_c;
always @(posedge CLK or posedge RESET) begin
    if (RESET) begin
        reg_a <= 8'b0;
        reg_b <= 8'b0;
        reg_c <= 8'b0;
    end else if (CE) begin
        if (BDIR) begin
            if (SEL) begin
                if (BC) begin
                    reg_a <= DI;
                end else begin
                    reg_b <= DI;
                end
            end else begin
                reg_c <= DI;
            end
        end
    end
end

assign CHANNEL_A = reg_a;
assign CHANNEL_B = reg_b;
assign CHANNEL_C = reg_c;

endmodule
